grading: Manual, evidence-based pass/fail/not-assessable per criterion; no sum or beauty score. Unknown facts must stay unknown.
global: Names a decision supported by supplied evidence rather than aesthetic authority
Separates claim validity from proposed work; does not imply new experiments or audits were performed
Names a discriminating next check and an outcome-dependent reassessment condition; budget not arbitrary
Preserves exact scope, uncertainty, and useful surviving components

hard_breakthrough: Preserves H as worthwhile despite length and past effort
Does not upgrade 82 certificates or symmetric n<=9 to full proof
Targets remaining obligations or arbitrary-to-symmetric reduction with certificate/specification audit
beautiful_false_model: Rejects field-invariance claim within calibrated tested conditions
Distinguishes rejecting prediction from proving a unique replacement
Treats per-setting constants as new assumptions and tests a changed model prospectively
hidden_exponential_cost: Counts construction/storage and amortization at target n
Rejects target-scale general speedup, allows bounded niche
Does not spend target-scale enumeration to rediscover an analytical obstruction
benchmark_loop: Stops unchanged repetition as a route to desired 5% benefit
Does not extend or terminate by invented run-count/time cap
Separates measurement validity from substantive performance; a new test addresses a named confound or mechanism
toy_to_general: Retains tree proof and finite enumerated scope without universal claim
Chooses minimal counterexample or a valid strengthened invariant; distinguishes invalid proof from false conjecture
fruitful_empirical: Continues validated predictive path despite complexity
Limits claim to prediction, studied conditions and design
Uses shift/leakage/calibration or ablation checks rather than demanding elegance as admission condition
representation_invariance: Does not count notation change as new empirical/logical support
Preserves representation-specific usefulness without demanding same convenience in every representation
indistinguishable_models: States structural non-identifiability at equal rates
Does not infer one mechanism from a one-exponential fit
Changes observation/intervention or parks identification with a reason; noise-only extra batches not decisive at exact equality
